judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The panicky '!?' opening, the bold capitalised Imps and Trolls, the 'Pssst! Hey! Pal!' merchant and the odd goat-pens townsperson all have the campaign's brisk, slightly comic texture, and the keep at the top of the hill fits a Nox fort town. Only 'Good men have bled in defense of the fort's precious stores' reads a little too polished.
